Good. Need to build the rest. Let's understand what's missing and what bugs exist.

Key pieces:
- main.js imports and GameUI class; no Game class, no boot, no input, no render loop, no class select rendering, no intro, no save/load wiring, no settings/credits, no audio maybe.
- world.js draw uses `this.drawEnemy` etc. Potential bug: iso coordinate mismatch. Camera uses world coordinates x,y but drawing uses iso(x,y) only for origin? Actually draw translates to -cam.x,-cam.y then draws ground rect 0..mapW, mapH. Ground is drawn in isometric projection width = w*1.732 but entities at world x,y not iso transformed. Hmm. The whole scene drawing uses x,y directly, not iso. Ground rect spans mapW=4157 x mapH=1800; that's 2.3x wide. Decor drawn at x,y. So player at 1200,900. It's essentially a top-down-ish scene stretched horizontally? Maybe intended iso but not applied. Wait `iso` used only for origin (unused). mapW = w*1.732, so ground 4157 wide. Camera x 1200. Player at center. Fine. It's just wide ground. Not ideal but playable. However minimap maps x/w so fine. Camera zoom 1, canvas 1280x720; visible world area 1280x720, okay.

- Combat: hitEnemy uses e.type to xp; loot drop; boss phases. Note `this.g.class` referenced in useSkill but game has cls. Need set game.class. We'll set both.
- `onKill` triggers quest transitions. Quest intro->hunt on first kill, hunt->boss at 6 kills. Interact with Maera sets hunt; so initial quest intro. Player spawns at 1200,900 near shrine. Interact at 1200,900. Good.
- Boss gate at 2020,930. Boss spawns when quest boss.
- On boss defeat sets quest done. Done quest objective "Speak with Maera". Need interact with Maera at shrine to complete game, maybe endgame panel. We should implement final victory: after boss dead, return to Maera and interact -> ending screen / endgame panel with "New Game+"? "finish the game" means make fully playable, maybe include ending.

Need to write main.js with:
- Canvas resize + DPR handling.
- Input WASD/arrows, click attack, skills 1-6, space dodge, E interact, Tab loot, R potion, I/K/M/J/C panels, Esc pause, F fullscreen? Maybe.
- Class select: render 6 class cards with mini canvas art. Need to draw class portraits/art. Could draw simple sigils. Also portrait canvas in HUD and speaker canvas.
- Intro cinematic with lines auto-advance? Buttons.
- Menu: continue/new/settings/credits.
- Save/load: capture player + inventory + quest/kills/boss flags, position, time. Restore.
- Pause screen: resume, settings, save&quit.
- Death screen: respawn at last waypoint (shrine) with half hp; abandon to menu.
- Panels: inventory, skills, map (draw large map on open), journal, character. Settings and credits panels.
- Level-up etc.

- Ability bar render from class skills, cooldown overlays updated each frame.
- Potion use (heal 40%).
- Dodge: space -> roll with invuln, move burst.
- Loot nearby (Tab) and auto? existing.
- Interact prompt detection near Maera/gate.
- Boss bar visibility.
- Minimap.

- Audio? Could add simple WebAudio ambience/hit sounds. Not necessary but adds polish. Maybe small sound system using oscillator; user gesture to start. Could implement subtle. But time.

- Render loop with fixed-ish dt, draw world, HUD, damage numbers. Need to ensure combat damage numbers draw after world draw. UI.update does drawDamage; call after world.draw.

- World update currently enemies attack regardless of pause; only call when not paused. Good.
- World update `updateEnemy` on death etc. Drops.
- `world.update` calls `this.g.combat.hitEnemy` projectiles. Fine.

- World draw `drawPlayer` references p.attackAnim etc. Fine.
- `drawDecor` uses rand in grass each frame -> flickering; minor. Could fix by using o.seed. Not critical but we can.

- Class art: implement in main.js drawing to canvas.

- Issue: `GameUI.updateHud` region banner show only once (regionTimer set), okay.

- `updateHud` quest tracker shows objectives; for intro includes "Find Warden Maera", "Defeat Cinder Husk", "Reach Emberfall shrine" all at once. Could make dynamic but okay. We can improve: objectives per state with checkmarks. Not essential.

- Need final ending. We can create endgame panel via openPanel('endgame') when quest done and interact Maera. CSS has endgame-list. Also allow continuing exploration after ending.

- Add "New Game+" maybe reset with level kept? Could be nice but not necessary. Endgame panel with "Continue exploring", "Begin a new chronicle" and "Nightmare" maybe. Keep scope manageable.

- Mobile controls: joystick and ability buttons. We can implement basic touch. Show if touch device or small width. Need mobile abilities render.

- Settings: volume, screen shake? damage numbers? We can store settings in localStorage. Implement game settings: master volume (audio), screen shake, show damage numbers, aim assist maybe. Use panel.

- Need avoid using `crypto.randomUUID` in non-secure contexts? fallback exists.

# Worker Agents Skills

This repository bundles the baseline skills installed by [Worker
Agents](https://github.com/agents-dev/workerAgents).

The bundled skills are available under [`skills/`](skills/):

- `mcp-duckgo` — imported from `aahl/skills@mcp-duckgo`.
- `image-search` — imported from `z0gsh1u/oh-my-writing-skill@image-search`.
- `gauntlet-loop` — imported from `robonuggets/gauntlet-loop@gauntlet-loop`.
- `load-sketchfab-threejs` — local asset inspection, normalization, and Three.js/PlayCanvas A/B viewer skill.
- `opencode-zen-completions` — use the OpenCode Zen chat completions API for implementation work.

The original upstream licenses are preserved in
[`third-party-licenses/`](third-party-licenses/).
name: OpenCode
run-name: "OpenCode #${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}${{ github.event.issue.title && format(' — {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}"

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: Existing issue to run
        required: true
        type: string

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: opencode-issue-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  prepare:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || (github.event.action == 'opened' && contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'OpenCode'))
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-prepare.yml@b69cee18134c605988f05c62a6f2873f77814d4d
    with:
      runtime_ref: b69cee18134c605988f05c62a6f2873f77814d4d

  opencode:
    needs: prepare
    if: needs.prepare.outputs.approved == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: read
      pull-requests: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-reusable.yml@b69cee18134c605988f05c62a6f2873f77814d4d

      runtime_ref: b69cee18134c605988f05c62a6f2873f77814d4d

      request: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.request }}
      issue_title: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.issue_title }}
      labels_json: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.labels_json }}
      sender: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.sender }}
      target_ref: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.target_ref }}

"PROJECT: ELDORIA — AGE OF RUIN

Complete Isometric Action RPG

Create an original, exceptionally polished dark fantasy action RPG set in the enormous fantasy world of Eldoria.

The game should take inspiration from the gameplay depth, combat responsiveness, loot systems, character progression, dungeon design, and atmospheric worldbuilding of Diablo IV.

Do not copy Diablo's characters, assets, maps, names, storylines, or interface. Create an entirely original intellectual property.

The objective is to create a deep, replayable action RPG that feels like a professionally developed commercial game.

1. THE WORLD OF ELDORIA

Eldoria was once a prosperous kingdom protected by seven ancient kingdoms and their sacred guardians.

An event known as The Sundering shattered the ancient seals that protected the world.

Now the land is infected by an ancient corruption called The Blight.

Entire cities have fallen. Ancient gods have disappeared. Demons, corrupted beasts, undead armies, and forgotten horrors roam the countryside.

The player is a newly awakened warrior who possesses an unusual ability to absorb fragments of ancient power.

A mysterious voice begins guiding the player, but its true identity and intentions remain unknown.

Create a serious, atmospheric dark fantasy storyline with meaningful characters, memorable villains, cinematic dialogue, major plot twists, and a compelling endgame mystery.

2. GRAPHICAL STYLE

Create a beautiful, dark, highly detailed 2.5D isometric world.

Visual quality is extremely important.

Use:

- Detailed environmental artwork.
- Atmospheric fog and volumetric lighting.
- Dynamic shadows.
- Beautiful spell effects.
- Detailed armor and weapons.
- Smooth character animations.
- Elaborate monster designs.
- Destructible environmental objects where appropriate.
- Detailed dungeon architecture.
- Dynamic weather and lighting.

The world should feel enormous, dangerous, and alive.

Avoid simplistic graphics, placeholder environments, generic assets, and repetitive dungeon rooms.

Maintain a consistent visual art direction throughout the entire game.

3. CAMERA AND MOVEMENT

Use a Diablo-style isometric camera.

Implement:

- Eight-direction movement.
- Smooth character movement.
- Responsive attack animations.
- Camera tracking.
- Mouse and keyboard support.
- Mobile touchscreen controls.
- Zoom controls where appropriate.

The camera must provide a clear view of enemies, attacks, environmental obstacles, and loot.

Combat must feel responsive and satisfying.

4. PLAYABLE CLASSES

Create six distinct playable classes.

WARRIOR:
Heavy armor, swords, axes, shields, powerful physical attacks, and devastating melee abilities.

MAGE:
Elemental magic, lightning, fire, ice, arcane projectiles, and powerful area attacks.

RANGER:
Bows, crossbows, traps, precision attacks, and rapid movement.

NECROMANCER:
Summon undead minions, manipulate souls, curse enemies, and control dark magic.

PALADIN:
Holy abilities, defensive auras, healing, shields, and powerful holy attacks.

ASSASSIN:
Dual blades, stealth, poison, critical strikes, and rapid combos.

Each class must have:

- Unique starting equipment.
- Unique skill trees.
- Class-specific abilities.
- Different combat animations.
- Class-specific passive bonuses.
- Multiple viable character builds.

5. COMBAT SYSTEM

Build a real-time action combat system.

Players should fight groups of enemies using basic attacks, active abilities, dodging, and defensive skills.

Include:

- Basic attacks.
- Six customizable ability slots.
- Cooldowns.
- Mana or class-specific resource management.
- Critical hits.
- Damage numbers.
- Status effects.
- Stuns and knockbacks.
- Area-of-effect attacks.
- Enemy attack indicators.
- Boss mechanics.
- Loot drops.

Combat should become increasingly exciting as players acquire stronger equipment and unlock abilities.

Avoid making enemies passive damage sponges.

Enemies must have recognizable attack patterns, different movement behaviors, and varying difficulty.

6. CHARACTER PROGRESSION

Create a deep progression system.

Include:

- Character levels.
- Attribute points.
- Skill trees.
- Passive abilities.
- Equipment progression.
- Class specialization.
- Legendary powers.
- Set bonuses.
- Endgame progression.

Every level should provide a meaningful improvement or unlock.

Allow players to experiment with different builds.

Make early progression approachable while allowing extremely complex builds at higher levels.

7. LOOT AND EQUIPMENT

Build a comprehensive randomized loot system.

Equipment slots:

- Helmet.
- Chest armor.
- Gloves.
- Pants.
- Boots.
- Main-hand weapon.
- Off-hand item.
- Amulet.
- Two rings.

Loot rarities:

1. Common
2. Magic
3. Rare
4. Epic
5. Legendary
6. Mythic

Equipment must have randomized attributes and meaningful differences.

Legendary items should have unique powers that can fundamentally change how abilities work.

Examples:

- A lightning spell that chains between additional enemies.
- A sword that creates an explosion after consecutive critical hits.
- Armor that summons a protective spirit when health becomes low.
- A bow that splits projectiles into multiple arrows.

Create hundreds of potential equipment combinations as the game expands.

Make loot exciting without making every drop powerful.

8. THE WORLD MAP

Build a large interconnected world containing distinct regions.

THE KINGDOM OF ASH:
Ruined villages, burned castles, undead armies, and abandoned fortresses.

THE WHISPERING WOODS:
Corrupted forests, giant beasts, ancient druid ruins, and hidden shrines.

THE FROZEN CITADEL:
Snow-covered fortresses, frozen caverns, and powerful ice creatures.

THE BLOODLANDS:
A corrupted wasteland filled with demons, blood cults, and dangerous dungeons.

THE SUNKEN KINGDOM:
An ancient civilization buried beneath the earth, containing forgotten treasures and terrifying creatures.

THE SHATTERED THRONE:
An endgame region containing the source of the Blight.

Each region must contain:

- Unique enemies.
- Rare resources.
- Side quests.
- Hidden locations.
- Dungeons.
- Elite monsters.
- World events.
- Region-specific bosses.

9. DUNGEON GENERATION

Create a replayable dungeon system.

Dungeons should feature:

- Randomized room layouts.
- Different enemy combinations.
- Elite enemies.
- Treasure rooms.
- Hidden passages.
- Environmental traps.
- Dungeon objectives.
- Final boss encounters.

Create handcrafted special dungeons with unique storylines and mechanics.

Dungeon difficulty should scale through multiple tiers.

10. ENEMY AND BOSS SYSTEM

Create a large enemy ecosystem.

Enemy categories:

- Undead.
- Demons.
- Corrupted wildlife.
- Cultists.
- Fallen knights.
- Ancient guardians.
- Elemental creatures.
- Eldritch horrors.

Include normal enemies, elite enemies, champions, mini-bosses, and major bosses.

Bosses must have multiple attack patterns, recognizable telegraphs, different combat phases, and unique rewards.

Boss encounters should feel like major accomplishments.

11. QUESTS AND STORY

Create a substantial main campaign with:

- Cinematic opening.
- Fully developed main characters.
- Voice-ready dialogue.
- Side quests.
- Optional discoveries.
- Hidden lore.
- Major story decisions.
- Dramatic boss encounters.
- Multiple story revelations.

The story should unfold naturally through exploration, dialogue, environmental storytelling, and dungeon discoveries.

12. ENDGAME

The game must have meaningful reasons to continue playing after the main campaign.

Include:

- Nightmare dungeon tiers.
- Endgame boss encounters.
- Rare Mythic equipment.
- Legendary crafting.
- Endless challenge dungeons.
- World boss events.
- Class-specific challenges.
- High-difficulty enemy modifiers.
- Build optimization.

The endgame should reward experimentation and mastery rather than simply increasing enemy health indefinitely.

13. USER INTERFACE

Create a premium dark fantasy interface.

Include:

- Character screen.
- Inventory.
- Skill tree.
- World map.
- Quest journal.
- Equipment comparison.
- Loot notifications.
- Settings.
- Main menu.
- Pause menu.

Use detailed icons, elegant typography, dark stone textures, subtle gold accents, and smooth transitions.

The interface must be readable and usable on both desktop and mobile.

14. TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Build a modular, scalable architecture.

Separate the systems for:

- Player movement.
- Combat.
- Classes.
- Skills.
- Enemies.
- Bosses.
- Loot generation.
- Inventory.
- Equipment.
- World generation.
- Dungeon generation.
- Quests.
- Character progression.
- Saving and loading.

Use persistent save data.

Optimize performance for mobile devices and desktop browsers.

Prevent duplicated items, broken inventory states, combat exploits, and lost progression.

15. DEVELOPMENT PRIORITIES

Do not attempt to implement every feature simultaneously.

First create a fully playable vertical slice containing:

1. Main menu.
2. Character selection with all six classes represented.
3. One playable class.
4. A beautiful opening region.
5. Isometric camera and movement.
6. Basic combat.
7. Three enemy types.
8. One elite enemy.
9. One fully functional boss.
10. Basic loot drops.
11. Inventory and equipment.
12. Character leveling.
13. Saving and loading.

Make this first playable area exceptionally polished.

Do not create decorative buttons that do nothing.

Do not replace functional systems with visual mockups.

Preserve existing working systems when expanding the game.

The ultimate goal is a complete, polished, content-rich dark fantasy action RPG set in Eldoria.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Continue from the existing Eldoria — Age of Ruin project and finish the complete, playable dark-fantasy action RPG.
- Preserve and expand the existing HTML5 canvas game with polished gameplay, content, UI, combat, loot, progression, and saving.

## Requirements
- Build a complete playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Original IP inspired by deep action RPGs, but do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Include a polished first playable area with isometric movement, basic combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Do not use decorative buttons that do nothing.
- Preserve functional systems when expanding.
- For checks, save small JPEG screenshots at paths and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- The existing implementation is a dependency-free HTML5 canvas game using ES modules and procedural art.
- Continue using the existing Eldoria systems rather than replacing them.
- Expanded loot content with additional class-specific and universal gear, affixes, and starter gear definitions.

## Work State

### Completed
- Existing project inspected; it contains a functional modular game in `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `src/*.js`.
- Existing systems identified: world generation/rendering, player movement, combat, progression, inventory/equipment, save/load, HUD, panels, dialogue, quests, and boss/death flows.
- `src/data.js` was edited to expand `LOOT_BASE` with additional equipment and add:
  - `AFFIXES`
  - `STARTER_GEAR`
  - Starter gear for warrior, mage, ranger, necromancer, paladin, and assassin.

### Active
- Finish and validate the game after the loot/data expansion.
- Verify that new data integrates with existing item generation, class selection, inventory, and UI.
- Run the game in a browser, exercise the main flow, and capture a latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- No known blocking issue, but the latest `src/data.js` change has not yet been syntax-checked or browser-tested.
- No screenshot or gameplay validation has been performed yet.

## Next Move
1. Inspect the complete current `src/data.js` and verify exports/syntax, especially the new `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` definitions.
2. Inspect `src/main.js` and related modules for assumptions about loot item IDs, class IDs, starter gear, and data exports; fix integration issues.
3. Start the project with the existing start command or a local static server.
4. Open the game with `playwright-cli`, select a class, enter gameplay, test movement, attack, skills, loot, inventory, save/load, and death/boss behavior.
5. Save a small JPEG screenshot of the latest working state and inspect it.
6. Run syntax/runtime checks and commit any final fixes; report assumptions and validation results.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Core classes, regions, quests, enemies, loot definitions; recently expanded with gear, affixes, and starter gear.
- `src/main.js`: Main game bootstrap, UI, input handling, screens, panels, save/load wiring, and game loop.
- `src/world.js`: Procedural world, entities, rendering, enemy behavior, drops, effects, and boss spawning.
- `src/combat.js`: Attacks, skills, damage, cooldowns, enemy/player hit handling, and death flow.
- `src/inventory.js`: Bag/equipment management, item equipping, stat recalculation, and serialization.
- `src/player.js`: Player creation and movement/state updates.
- `src/progression.js`: XP and level-up logic.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load implementation.
- `index.html`: Game canvas and all HUD/menu/panel markup.
- `styles.css`: Full visual styling, responsive layout, HUD, menus, panels, and game overlays.
- `.omgithub/conversation.json`: Original project request and prior assistant conversation, if additional context is needed.

## Important Context
- Repository was clean before the latest edit; after editing `src/data.js`, changes are uncommitted.
- Existing branch was `opencode/42430273437`.
- The original request called the project “ELDORIA — AGE OF RUIN” and specified a complete polished dark-fantasy action RPG.
- Existing code is compact and highly minified in places; preserve its style and inspect full files before making targeted changes.
- The latest change added starter gear keyed by class IDs: `warrior`, `mage`, `ranger`, `necromancer`, `paladin`, and `assassin`; confirm these exactly match `CLASSES`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Finish and validate the existing **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG as a complete playable game.
- Continue the existing modular implementation, preserving functional gameplay systems while expanding content and polish.

## Requirements
- Build without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them when finished.
- Include isometric movement, basic combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing.
- Preserve functional systems when expanding.
- For checks, save small JPEG screenshots at paths no wider than 1280px and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Continue using the dependency-free HTML5 canvas architecture with ES modules and procedural art.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them.
- Add class-specific and universal equipment, affixes, and starter gear while retaining existing loot generation and UI patterns.
- Use the existing local static server for browser validation.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected the existing game architecture and core modules.
- Expanded `src/data.js` with additional `LOOT_BASE` items, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` for `warrior`, `mage`, `ranger`, `necromancer`, `paladin`, and `assassin`.
- Confirmed the starter gear class IDs match the six class IDs in `CLASSES`.
- Ran `node --check` successfully on every file in `src/*.js`.
- Started a local server with `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
- Captured the latest browser screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg` using Chromium at 1280×720; capture completed successfully.
- Confirmed the repository currently has only the uncommitted `src/data.js` modification.

### Active
- Validate the game interactively in a browser, including class selection, entering gameplay, movement, attacking, abilities, loot pickup, inventory/equipment, save/load, death/respawn, and boss flow.
- Verify that newly added `STARTER_GEAR` and `AFFIXES` are actually integrated; current grep shows they are exported but not referenced by gameplay code.
- Inspect the latest screenshot and resolve any visible or runtime issues.
- Add missing integration for starter gear/affixes if required, then rerun checks and capture a final screenshot.

### Blocked
- No known hard blocker.
- Automated browser interaction tooling was not established; Chromium headless screenshot capture works, but functional interaction still needs validation.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg` as the latest screenshot and check for visible startup/rendering problems.
2. Use available browser automation or Chromium scripting to exercise the main menu, class selection, intro, gameplay, combat, panels, and save flow.
3. Integrate `STARTER_GEAR` into new-player creation and apply `AFFIXES` during item generation if those systems are intended to be functional.
4. Fix any runtime errors or broken UI actions discovered during testing.
5. Rerun `node --check src/*.js` and capture a final small JPEG screenshot.
6. Review `git diff`, preserve the uncommitted changes unless the user requests a commit, and report validation results and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Classes, enemies, loot definitions, affixes, and starter gear; latest modified file.
- `src/main.js`: Game bootstrap, UI, screens, input, panels, save/load wiring, quests, and boss/death flows.
- `src/world.js`: Procedural world generation/rendering, enemies, drops, effects, and boss spawning.
- `src/combat.js`: Basic attacks, skills, damage, enemy/player hit handling, and death behavior.
- `src/inventory.js`: Bag/equipment management, item equipping, stat recalculation, and serialization.
- `src/player.js`: Player creation and movement/state initialization.
- `src/progression.js`: XP, level-up, stat growth, and resource progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load implementation.
- `index.html`: Canvas, HUD, menus, panels, dialogue, boss, and death UI.
- `styles.css`: Game presentation, HUD, menus, panels, responsive layout, and overlays.
- `README.md`: Project metadata and links.
- `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`: Latest browser screenshot for visual inspection.

## Important Context
- `STARTER_GEAR` and `AFFIXES` currently exist only as exports in `src/data.js`; no references were found in `src/main.js`, `src/player.js`, `src/inventory.js`, or `src/world.js`.
- `World.dropFor()` currently chooses a random `LOOT_BASE` item and assigns rarity/power, but does not apply affixes.
- `Inventory` accepts saved inventory data and recalculates equipment stats, but new players currently do not visibly receive the newly defined starter gear.
- `Combat.useSkill()` contains a bug risk: its insufficient-resource message references `this.g.class.resource`, while the game state uses `classId` and does not visibly define `g.class`; verify at runtime.
- The latest screenshot was captured successfully, but it has not yet been read or visually assessed.

## Objective
- Finish and validate the existing **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG as a complete playable game.
- Continue the modular implementation while preserving functional gameplay systems and adding content/polish.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them when finished.
- Include isometric movement, basic combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing.
- Preserve functional systems when expanding.
- For checks, save small JPEG screenshots at paths no wider than 1280px and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Continue using the dependency-free HTML5 canvas architecture with ES modules and procedural art.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them.
- Add class-specific and universal equipment, affixes, and starter gear while retaining existing loot generation and UI patterns.
- Use the existing local static server for browser validation.

### Completed
- Inspected the existing game architecture and core modules.
- Expanded `src/data.js` with additional `LOOT_BASE` items, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` for all six classes.

### Active
- Validate gameplay interactively in a browser: class selection, entering gameplay, movement, attacking, abilities, loot pickup, inventory/equipment, save/load, death/respawn, and boss flow.

- Inspect the latest screenshot for visible startup/rendering problems and capture a final screenshot after fixes.

## Objective
- Finish and validate the existing **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG as a complete playable game, preserving its systems while adding content and polish.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, basic combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing.
- Preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate with browser interaction and save screenshots as JPEGs no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue using the dependency-free HTML5 canvas architecture with ES modules and procedural art.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them.
- Add class-specific and universal equipment, affixes, and starter gear while retaining existing loot generation and UI patterns.
- Use the existing local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game architecture and confirmed existing movement, combat, enemy types, elite, boss, loot, inventory/equipment, progression, and save/load systems.
- Expanded `src/data.js` with `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` for six classes; changes remain uncommitted.
- Confirmed starter gear class IDs match the six defined class IDs.
- Ran `node --check` successfully on all `src/*.js` files before the latest implementation work.
- Confirmed `index.html` loads `src/main.js` and contains the expected menu, class selection, intro, pause, death, HUD, panel, dialogue, and gameplay elements.
- Identified that `src/main.js` currently ends at line 43 after `GameUI.bindSkills()`, with no visible game bootstrap, event wiring, or animation loop.
- Located required integration points: `createPlayer()`, `World.dropFor()`, `Inventory.recalculate()`, and `Combat.useSkill()`.

### Active
- Restore or implement the missing bootstrap, input/event wiring, game loop, screen transitions, and gameplay initialization in `src/main.js`.
- Integrate `STARTER_GEAR` into new-player creation and equip or add starter items through `Inventory`.
- Apply `AFFIXES` in `World.dropFor()` while preserving rarity and power behavior.
- Extend `Inventory.recalculate()` to apply affix stats such as damage, health, speed, crit, armor, and resource.
- Fix the insufficient-resource message in `Combat.useSkill()`; it currently references nonexistent `this.g.class.resource` instead of resolving the class from `p.classId`.
- Validate class selection, intro, gameplay entry, movement, attacking, abilities, loot pickup, inventory/equipment, save/load, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser.
- Capture and inspect the final screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`.

### Blocked
- Browser interaction validation is blocked until the missing `src/main.js` bootstrap and event-loop wiring are restored or implemented.
- The current `src/main.js` UI class references many expected controls and systems but does not instantiate `GameUI`, `World`, `Combat`, `Progression`, or `Inventory`, nor connect menu/input handlers.

## Next Move
1. Inspect any remaining repository history or files for the missing `main.js` bootstrap before implementing it.
2. Preserve the uncommitted `src/data.js` changes while adding starter gear, affixes, inventory stat handling, and the combat resource-message fix.
3. Implement and wire the main game lifecycle, controls, rendering loop, menus, save/load, pause, respawn, and panel actions in `src/main.js`.
4. Run syntax checks for every source module and launch the local server with `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
5. Exercise the complete gameplay flow in a browser, fix runtime issues, and capture/read `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`.
6. Review `git diff` and report final assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI methods exist, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop appear missing.
- `src/data.js`: Classes, enemies, loot definitions, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR`; contains uncommitted changes.
- `src/world.js`: World generation, rendering, enemies, drops, and `dropFor()` needing affix integration.
- `src/combat.js`: Combat and skills; contains the `this.g.class.resource` bug.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment, bag management, stat recalculation, and serialization; needs affix support.
- `src/player.js`: Player creation and movement; needs starter-gear integration at initialization.
- `src/progression.js`: XP, level-up, stat growth, and resource progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load implementation.
- `index.html`: Canvas, HUD, menus, panels, dialogue, boss, pause, and death controls.
- `styles.css`: UI layout, overlays, panels, HUD, and responsive presentation.
- `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`: Latest browser screenshot to replace and inspect after fixes.

## Important Context
- `src/main.js` is only 43 lines and ends immediately after `GameUI.bindSkills()`; this is the primary unresolved issue.
- `game` state includes `player`, `world`, `combat`, `progression`, `inventory`, `ui`, pause/death flags, quest state, kill count, boss state, class selection, keyboard state, pointer, and time.
- `createPlayer()` accepts `(classId, name, saved)` and initializes baseline stats but currently provides no starter equipment.
- `World.dropFor()` currently chooses a random `LOOT_BASE` item, assigns rarity/power, and does not apply affixes.
- `Inventory.recalculate()` currently accounts only for weapon/armor power and does not apply affix stats.
- `Combat.useSkill()` has the exact faulty expression `this.g.class.resource`; game state has `player.classId` and no confirmed `g.class` property.
- `git status --short` currently shows only `M src/data.js`; no other changes were confirmed.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected existing game systems and identified the missing `src/main.js` bootstrap and integration points.
- Expanded `src/data.js` with `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` for six classes; these changes are uncommitted.
- Fixed the bad resource-message lookup in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js` to resolve the resource name from `player.classId`; not yet validated.

### Active
- Implement bootstrap, input/event wiring, game loop, screen transitions, and gameplay initialization in `src/main.js`.
- Integrate starter gear, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation.
- Validate menus, gameplay, combat, loot, inventory/equipment, save/load, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Inspect repository history or other files for the missing `src/main.js` bootstrap.
2. Preserve uncommitted data changes; integrate starter gear, affixes, and their stats.
3. Complete `src/main.js` lifecycle and controls; check all UI actions against `index.html`.
4. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
5. Exercise the gameplay flows in a browser; fix runtime issues and save/read `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`.
6. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI class exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `src/data.js`: Uncommitted loot, affix, and starter gear definitions.
- `src/world.js`: `dropFor()` needs affix integration.
- `src/inventory.js`: `recalculate()` needs affix stats.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` needs starter gear integration.
- `src/combat.js`: Resource-message lookup was just fixed; needs validation.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `index.html`: Menu, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- `src/main.js` is only 43 lines and ends at `GameUI.bindSkills()`; it does not instantiate the game systems or connect controls.
- `createPlayer(classId, name, saved)` currently has no starter-equipment setup.
- `World.dropFor()` currently assigns rarity and power but no affixes.
- `Inventory.recalculate()` currently uses equipment power only.
- `Combat.useSkill()` resource message now maps `player.classId` to a resource label; no syntax or browser check has been run after the change.
- Previous syntax checks passed before the latest implementation work; current changes remain uncommitted.

## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected core systems, UI markup, loot data, and game lifecycle; confirmed `src/main.js` has UI methods but no bootstrap, event wiring, or game loop.
- Added `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` data in `src/data.js` (uncommitted).
- Updated `Combat.useSkill()` resource warning in `src/combat.js` to resolve the resource label from `player.classId` (uncommitted).

### Active
- Implement `src/main.js` bootstrap, controls, event wiring, game loop, and screen transitions.
- Integrate starter equipment, affixes, and affix stat recalculation.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement the missing `src/main.js` lifecycle and controls; wire every relevant action in `index.html`.
2. Preserve current uncommitted changes; integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI class exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `src/data.js`: Uncommitted loot, affix, and starter gear definitions.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` still does not apply starter equipment.
- `src/world.js`: `World.dropFor()` assigns rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: `recalculate()` uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Resource-message lookup was changed; not yet validated.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `index.html`: Menu, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- `src/main.js` is only 43 lines and ends at `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- `src/player.js` remains unchanged; a targeted edit to add starter gear failed because the exact source text did not match.
- `git status --short` showed uncommitted modifications to `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js`; no syntax or browser checks have been run after these changes.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` data in `src/data.js` (uncommitted).
- Updated `Combat.useSkill()` resource warning in `src/combat.js` to resolve the resource label from `player.classId` (uncommitted).
- Inspected game lifecycle, UI, combat, world, player, inventory, progression, and save code.

### Active
- Implement `src/main.js` bootstrap, controls, event wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; it currently ends at `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement the missing `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire relevant actions in `index.html`.
2. Preserve current uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Uncommitted loot, affix, and starter gear definitions.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` remains unchanged; attempted targeted edit failed due to source-text mismatch.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Uncommitted resource-message change; not yet validated.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- `git status --short` previously showed uncommitted modifications to `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js`; no syntax or browser checks have been run.
- `index.html` has controls for Continue/New Game/Settings/Credits, class selection, pause, save/quit, respawn, panels, and dialogue; ensure interactive controls have behavior.

## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` data in `src/data.js` (uncommitted).
- Updated the resource warning in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js` to use the player class’s resource label (uncommitted).
- Inspected game lifecycle, UI, combat, world, player, inventory, progression, and save code.

### Active
- Implement `src/main.js` bootstrap, controls, event wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; the file currently ends at `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement the missing `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire relevant actions in `index.html`.
2. Preserve current uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Uncommitted loot, affix, and starter gear definitions.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` remains unchanged; a targeted edit previously failed due to source-text mismatch.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Uncommitted resource-message change; not yet validated.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- `git status --short` previously showed uncommitted modifications to `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js`; no syntax or browser checks have been run.
- `index.html` has controls for Continue/New Game/Settings/Credits, class selection, pause, save/quit, respawn, panels, and dialogue; ensure interactive controls have behavior.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` data in `src/data.js` (uncommitted).
- Updated the resource warning in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js` to use the player class’s resource label (uncommitted).
- Inspected game lifecycle, UI, combat, world, player, inventory, progression, and save code.

### Active
- Implement `src/main.js` bootstrap, controls, event wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; current file ends at `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement the missing `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire relevant actions in `index.html`.
2. Preserve current uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Uncommitted loot, affix, and starter gear definitions.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` remains unchanged; a targeted edit previously failed due to source-text mismatch.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Uncommitted resource-message change; not yet validated.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Latest `git status --short` showed uncommitted modifications to `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js`; no syntax or browser checks have been run.
- `index.html` has controls for Continue/New Game/Settings/Credits, class selection, pause, save/quit, respawn, panels, and dialogue; ensure interactive controls have behavior.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` data in `src/data.js` (uncommitted).
- Updated the resource warning in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js` to use the player class’s resource label (uncommitted).
- Inspected game lifecycle, UI, combat, world, player, inventory, progression, save code, and relevant HTML controls.

### Active
- Implement `src/main.js` bootstrap, controls, event wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; current file ends at `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement the missing `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire all relevant actions in `index.html`.
2. Preserve current uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Uncommitted loot, affix, and starter gear definitions.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` remains unchanged; a targeted edit previously failed due to source-text mismatch.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Uncommitted resource-message change; not yet validated.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Latest `git status --short` showed uncommitted modifications to `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js`; no syntax or browser checks have been run.
- `index.html` has controls for Continue/New Game/Settings/Credits, class selection, pause, save/quit, respawn, panels, and dialogue; ensure interactive controls have behavior.

## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` definitions in `src/data.js` (uncommitted).
- Updated resource-warning text in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js` to use the player class’s resource label (uncommitted).
- Inspected game UI, lifecycle, combat, world, player, inventory, progression, save code, and HTML controls.

### Active
- Complete `src/main.js` bootstrap, control wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; current file ends after `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser.

### Blocked
- Browser validation is blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire all relevant controls in `index.html`.
2. Preserve existing uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Uncommitted loot, affix, and starter gear definitions.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` remains unchanged; a targeted edit previously failed due to source-text mismatch.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Uncommitted resource-message change; not yet validated.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Latest `git status --short` showed uncommitted modifications to `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js`; no syntax or browser checks have been run.
- `index.html` has controls for Continue/New Game/Settings/Credits, class selection, pause, save/quit, respawn, panels, and dialogue; ensure interactive controls have behavior.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` definitions in `src/data.js` (uncommitted).
- Updated resource-warning text in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js` to use the player class’s resource label (uncommitted).
- Inspected UI, lifecycle, combat, world, player, inventory, progression, save code, and HTML controls.

### Active
- Complete `src/main.js` bootstrap, control wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; current file ends after `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire all relevant controls in `index.html`.
2. Preserve existing uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Uncommitted loot, affix, and starter gear definitions.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` remains unchanged; prior targeted edit failed due to source-text mismatch.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Uncommitted resource-message change; not yet validated.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Latest observed `git status --short`: `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js` modified; changes are uncommitted.
- No syntax checks or browser validation have been run.
- `index.html` has controls for Continue/New Game/Settings/Credits, class selection, pause, save/quit, respawn, panels, and dialogue; ensure interactive controls have behavior.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` definitions in `src/data.js` (uncommitted).
- Updated resource-warning text in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js` to use the player class’s resource label (uncommitted).
- Inspected UI, lifecycle, combat, world, player, inventory, progression, save code, and HTML controls.

### Active
- Complete `src/main.js` bootstrap, control wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; file currently ends after `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire relevant controls in `index.html`.
2. Preserve existing uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Uncommitted loot, affix, and starter gear definitions.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` remains unchanged; starter gear integration is pending.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Uncommitted class-specific resource warning change.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Latest observed `git status --short`: `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js` modified; changes are uncommitted.
- No syntax checks or browser validation have been run.
- `index.html` includes controls for Continue/New Game/Settings/Credits, class selection, pause, save/quit, respawn, panels, and dialogue; ensure interactive controls have behavior.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` definitions in `src/data.js`.
- Updated resource-warning text in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js`.
- Inspected UI, lifecycle, combat, world, player, inventory, progression, save code, and HTML controls.

### Active
- Complete `src/main.js` bootstrap, control wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; the file still ends after `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire relevant controls in `index.html`.
2. Preserve existing uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Loot, affix, and starter gear definitions are present.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` remains unchanged; starter gear integration is pending.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Contains the class-specific resource warning change.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Latest observed `git status --short`: `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js` modified; changes are uncommitted.
- No syntax checks or browser validation have been run.
- `index.html` includes controls for Continue/New Game/Settings/Credits, class selection, pause, save/quit, respawn, panels, and dialogue; ensure interactive controls have behavior.

## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` definitions in `src/data.js`.
- Updated resource-warning text in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js`.
- Inspected UI, lifecycle, combat, world, player, inventory, progression, save code, and HTML controls.

### Active
- Complete `src/main.js` bootstrap, control wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; the file still ends after `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire relevant controls in `index.html`.
2. Preserve existing uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Loot, affix, and starter gear definitions are present.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` remains unchanged; starter gear integration is pending.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Contains the class-specific resource warning change.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Latest observed `git status --short`: `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js` modified; changes are uncommitted.
- No syntax checks or browser validation have been run.
- `index.html` includes controls for Continue/New Game/Settings/Credits, class selection, pause, save/quit, respawn, panels, and dialogue; ensure interactive controls have behavior.

## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` definitions in `src/data.js`.
- Updated resource-warning text in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js`.
- Inspected UI, lifecycle, combat, world, player, inventory, progression, save code, and HTML controls.

### Active
- Complete `src/main.js` bootstrap, control wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; it currently ends after `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire relevant controls in `index.html`.
2. Preserve existing uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Loot, affix, and starter gear definitions are present.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` remains unchanged; starter gear integration is pending.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Contains the class-specific resource warning change.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Latest observed `git status --short`: `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js` modified; changes are uncommitted.
- No syntax checks or browser validation have been run.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` definitions in `src/data.js`.
- Updated resource-warning text in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js`.
- Inspected UI, lifecycle, combat, world, player, inventory, progression, save code, and HTML controls.

### Active
- Complete `src/main.js` bootstrap, control wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; it currently ends after `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire relevant controls in `index.html`.
2. Preserve existing uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Loot, affix, and starter gear definitions are present.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` remains unchanged; starter gear integration is pending.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Contains the class-specific resource warning change.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Latest observed `git status --short`: `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js` modified; changes are uncommitted.
- The `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` additions are present; `LOOT_BASE` also has corrected `Cinderstep Boots` field order and several added items.
- No syntax checks or browser validation have been run.
