## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` definitions in `src/data.js`.
- Updated resource-warning text in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js`.
- Inspected game UI, lifecycle, combat, world, player, inventory, progression, save code, and HTML controls.

### Active
- Complete `src/main.js` bootstrap, control wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; the file currently ends after `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire relevant controls in `index.html`.
2. Preserve existing uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Loot, affix, and starter gear definitions are present.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` remains unchanged; starter gear integration is pending.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Contains the class-specific resource warning change.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Latest observed `git status --short` before the recent inspection: `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js` modified; changes are uncommitted.
- `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` additions are present; `LOOT_BASE` includes corrected `Cinderstep Boots` field order and several added items.
- `src/main.js` has no bootstrap or game loop beyond the `GameUI` class methods; syntax checks and browser validation have not been run.

1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` definitions in `src/data.js`.
- Updated resource-warning text in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js`.
- Inspected game UI, lifecycle, combat, world, player, inventory, progression, save code, and HTML controls.

### Active
- Complete `src/main.js` bootstrap, control wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; the file currently ends after `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire relevant controls in `index.html`.
2. Preserve existing uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Loot, affix, and starter gear definitions are present.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` remains unchanged; starter gear integration is pending.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Contains the class-specific resource warning change.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Latest observed `git status --short`: `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js` modified; changes are uncommitted.
- `LOOT_BASE` includes corrected `Cinderstep Boots` field order and several added items.
- `src/main.js` contains `GameUI`, including a dynamically rendered inventory panel, but no bootstrap or game loop; syntax checks and browser validation have not been run.

## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` definitions in `src/data.js`.
- Updated resource-warning text in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js`.
- Inspected UI controls, combat, world, player, inventory, progression, and save/load implementations.

### Active
- Complete `src/main.js` bootstrap, control wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; file currently ends after `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire relevant controls in `index.html`.
2. Preserve existing uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Loot, affix, and starter gear definitions are present.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` remains unchanged; starter gear integration is pending.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Contains the class-specific resource warning change.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Latest observed Git status: `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js` modified; changes are uncommitted.
- `LOOT_BASE` includes corrected `Cinderstep Boots` field order and several added items.
- `GameUI` includes a dynamically rendered inventory panel; no bootstrap or game loop has been implemented.
- Syntax checks and browser validation have not been run.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` definitions in `src/data.js`.
- Updated resource-warning text in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js`.
- Inspected UI controls, combat, world, player, inventory, progression, save/load, and relevant HTML/CSS.

### Active
- Complete `src/main.js` bootstrap, control wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; file currently ends after `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire relevant controls in `index.html`.
2. Preserve existing uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Loot, affix, and starter gear definitions are present.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` remains unchanged; starter gear integration is pending.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Contains the class-specific resource warning change.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Latest observed Git status: `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js` modified; changes are uncommitted.
- `LOOT_BASE` includes corrected `Cinderstep Boots` field order and several added items.
- `GameUI` includes a dynamically rendered inventory panel; no bootstrap or game loop has been implemented.
- Syntax checks and browser validation have not been run.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` definitions in `src/data.js`.
- Updated resource-warning text in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js`.
- Inspected UI controls, combat, world, player, inventory, progression, save/load, HTML, and CSS.

### Active
- Complete `src/main.js` bootstrap, control wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; the file currently ends after `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire controls in `index.html`.
2. Preserve existing uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Loot, affix, and starter gear definitions are present.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` remains unchanged; starter gear integration is pending.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Contains the class-specific resource warning change.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Latest observed Git status: `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js` modified; changes are uncommitted.
- `LOOT_BASE` includes corrected `Cinderstep Boots` field order and several added items.
- `GameUI` includes a dynamically rendered inventory panel; no bootstrap or game loop has been implemented.
- Main-menu, class selection, cinematic, pause, death, panel, dialogue, and HUD controls are in `index.html`.
- Syntax checks and browser validation have not been run.

## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` definitions in `src/data.js`.
- Updated resource-warning text in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js`.
- Inspected UI controls, combat, world, player, inventory, progression, save/load, HTML, and CSS.

### Active
- Complete `src/main.js` bootstrap, control wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; it currently ends after `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire controls in `index.html`.
2. Preserve existing uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Loot, affix, and starter gear definitions are present.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` remains unchanged; starter gear integration is pending.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Contains the class-specific resource warning change.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Latest observed Git status: `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js` modified; changes are uncommitted.
- `LOOT_BASE` includes corrected `Cinderstep Boots` field order and several added items.
- `GameUI` includes a dynamically rendered inventory panel; no bootstrap or game loop has been implemented.
- Main-menu, class selection, cinematic, pause, death, panel, dialogue, and HUD controls are in `index.html`.
- Syntax checks and browser validation have not been run.

- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.

- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.

## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` definitions in `src/data.js`.
- Updated resource-warning text in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js`.
- Inspected UI controls, combat, world, player, inventory, progression, save/load, HTML, and CSS.

### Active
- Complete `src/main.js` bootstrap, control wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; it currently ends after `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser; save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Browser validation is blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire controls in `index.html`.
2. Preserve existing uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Loot, affix, and starter gear definitions are present.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` remains unchanged; starter gear integration is pending.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Contains the class-specific resource warning change.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Latest observed Git status: `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js` modified; changes are uncommitted.
- `LOOT_BASE` includes corrected `Cinderstep Boots` field order and several added items.
- `GameUI` includes a dynamically rendered inventory panel; no bootstrap or game loop has been implemented.
- Main-menu, class selection, cinematic, pause, death, panel, dialogue, and HUD controls are in `index.html`.
- Syntax checks and browser validation have not been run.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` definitions in `src/data.js`.
- Updated resource-warning text in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js`.
- Inspected UI controls, combat, world, player, inventory, progression, save/load, HTML, and CSS.

### Active
- Complete `src/main.js` bootstrap, control wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; it currently ends after `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser; save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Browser validation is blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire controls in `index.html`.
2. Preserve existing uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Loot, affix, and starter gear definitions are present.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` remains unchanged; starter gear integration is pending.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Contains the class-specific resource warning change.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Latest observed Git status: `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js` modified; changes are uncommitted.
- `LOOT_BASE` includes corrected `Cinderstep Boots` field order and several added items.
- `GameUI` includes a dynamically rendered inventory panel; no bootstrap or game loop has been implemented.
- Main-menu, class selection, cinematic, pause, death, panel, dialogue, and HUD controls are in `index.html`.
- Syntax checks and browser validation have not been run.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR` definitions in `src/data.js`.
- Updated resource-warning text in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js`.
- Inspected UI controls, combat, world, player, inventory, progression, save/load, HTML, and CSS.

### Active
- Complete `src/main.js` bootstrap, control wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; it currently ends after `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser; save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire controls in `index.html`.
2. Preserve existing uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Loot, affix, and starter gear definitions are present.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` remains unchanged; starter gear integration is pending.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Contains the class-specific resource warning change.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Latest observed Git status: `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js` modified; changes are uncommitted.
- `LOOT_BASE` includes corrected `Cinderstep Boots` field order and several added items.
- `GameUI` includes a dynamically rendered inventory panel; no bootstrap or game loop has been implemented.
- Main-menu, class selection, cinematic, pause, death, panel, dialogue, and HUD controls are in `index.html`.
- Syntax checks and browser validation have not been run.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/data.js` contains `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR`; corrected the `Cinderstep Boots` field order.
- Updated resource-warning text in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js`.
- Inspected UI controls, combat, world, player, inventory, progression, save/load, HTML, and CSS.

### Active
- Complete `src/main.js` bootstrap, control wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; it currently ends after `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser; save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire controls in `index.html`.
2. Preserve existing uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, class selection, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Loot, affix, and starter gear definitions are present.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` remains unchanged; starter gear integration is pending.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Contains the class-specific resource warning change.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Latest observed Git status: `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js` modified; changes are uncommitted.
- `GameUI` includes a dynamically rendered inventory panel; no bootstrap or game loop has been implemented.
- Main-menu, class selection, cinematic, pause, death, panel, dialogue, and HUD controls are in `index.html`.
- Additional inspection confirms `src/main.js` currently has 43 lines and ends at `bindSkills()`; `World`, `Combat`, `Progression`, and `Inventory` expose the gameplay primitives needed for the bootstrap.
- Syntax checks and browser validation have not been run.

## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/data.js` contains `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR`; corrected the `Cinderstep Boots` field order.
- Updated resource-warning text in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js`.
- Inspected UI controls, combat, world, player, inventory, progression, save/load, HTML, and CSS.

### Active
- Complete `src/main.js` bootstrap, control wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; it currently ends after `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser; save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire controls in `index.html`.
2. Preserve existing uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, class selection, cinematic, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Loot, affix, and starter gear definitions are present.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` remains unchanged; starter gear integration is pending.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Contains the class-specific resource warning change.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Latest observed Git status: `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js` modified; changes are uncommitted.
- `GameUI` includes a dynamically rendered inventory panel; no bootstrap or game loop has been implemented.
- Main-menu, class selection, cinematic, pause, death, panel, dialogue, and HUD controls are in `index.html`.
- `src/main.js` is 43 lines and ends at `bindSkills()`; `World`, `Combat`, `Progression`, and `Inventory` expose the gameplay primitives needed for the bootstrap.
- Syntax checks and browser validation have not been run.

## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/data.js` contains `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR`; corrected the `Cinderstep Boots` field order.
- Updated resource-warning text in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js`.
- Added `baseMaxResource`, `baseSpeed`, and `baseCrit` defaults in `createPlayer()` in `src/player.js`.

### Active
- Complete `src/main.js` bootstrap, control wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; it currently ends after `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser; save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire controls in `index.html`.
2. Preserve existing uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, class selection, cinematic, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Loot, affix, and starter gear definitions are present.

- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/data.js` contains `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR`; corrected the `Cinderstep Boots` field order.
- Updated resource-warning text in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js`.
- Added `baseMaxResource`, `baseSpeed`, and `baseCrit` defaults in `createPlayer()` in `src/player.js`.

### Active
- Complete `src/main.js` bootstrap, control wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; it currently ends after `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser; save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire controls in `index.html`.
2. Preserve existing uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, class selection, cinematic, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Loot, affix, and starter gear definitions are present.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` has base-stat defaults; starter gear integration remains pending.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Contains the class-specific resource warning change.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; latest known status before editing `src/player.js` showed `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js` modified; `src/player.js` has since also been modified.
- `GameUI` includes a dynamically rendered inventory panel; no bootstrap or game loop has been implemented.
- Main-menu, class selection, cinematic, pause, death, panel, dialogue, and HUD controls are in `index.html`.
- `World`, `Combat`, `Progression`, and `Inventory` expose the gameplay primitives needed for the bootstrap.
- Syntax checks and browser validation have not been run.

## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/data.js` contains `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR`; corrected the `Cinderstep Boots` field order.
- Updated resource-warning text in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js`.
- Added `baseMaxResource`, `baseSpeed`, and `baseCrit` defaults in `createPlayer()` in `src/player.js`.

### Active
- Complete `src/main.js` bootstrap, control wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; it currently ends after `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser; save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire controls in `index.html`.
2. Preserve existing uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, class selection, cinematic, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Loot, affix, and starter gear definitions are present.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` has base-stat defaults; starter gear integration remains pending.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Contains the class-specific resource warning change.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; latest known status before editing `src/player.js` showed `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js` modified; `src/player.js` has since also been modified.
- `GameUI` includes a dynamically rendered inventory panel; no bootstrap or game loop has been implemented.
- Main-menu, class selection, cinematic, pause, death, panel, dialogue, and HUD controls are in `index.html`.
- `World`, `Combat`, `Progression`, and `Inventory` expose the gameplay primitives needed for the bootstrap.
- Syntax checks and browser validation have not been run.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/data.js` contains `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR`; corrected the `Cinderstep Boots` field order.
- Updated resource-warning text in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js`.
- Added `baseMaxResource`, `baseSpeed`, and `baseCrit` defaults in `createPlayer()` in `src/player.js`.

### Active
- Complete `src/main.js` bootstrap, control wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; it currently ends after `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser; save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire controls in `index.html`.
2. Preserve existing uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, class selection, cinematic, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Loot, affix, and starter gear definitions are present.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` has base-stat defaults; starter gear integration remains pending.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Contains the class-specific resource warning change.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; latest known status before editing `src/player.js` showed `src/combat.js` and `src/data.js` modified; `src/player.js` has since also been modified.
- `GameUI` includes a dynamically rendered inventory panel; no bootstrap or game loop has been implemented.
- Main-menu, class selection, cinematic, pause, death, panel, dialogue, and HUD controls are in `index.html`.
- `World`, `Combat`, `Progression`, and `Inventory` expose the gameplay primitives needed for the bootstrap.
- Syntax checks and browser validation have not been run.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Finish and validate **Eldoria — Age of Ruin** as a playable HTML5 canvas dark-fantasy action RPG while preserving its existing systems.

## Requirements
- Include isometric movement, combat, at least three enemy types, an elite, a functional boss, loot, inventory/equipment, leveling, and save/load.
- Use original IP; do not copy Diablo characters, assets, maps, storylines, or interface.
- Do not add decorative buttons that do nothing; preserve functional systems when expanding.
- Validate through browser interaction and save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.
- Build without clarification questions; note reasonable assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Continue with the dependency-free HTML5 canvas and ES modules.
- Expand existing systems instead of replacing them; use the local static server for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/data.js` contains `LOOT_BASE`, `AFFIXES`, and `STARTER_GEAR`; corrected the `Cinderstep Boots` field order.
- Updated resource-warning text in `Combat.useSkill()` in `src/combat.js`.
- Added `baseMaxResource`, `baseSpeed`, and `baseCrit` defaults in `createPlayer()` in `src/player.js`.

### Active
- Complete `src/main.js` bootstrap, control wiring, game loop, and screen transitions; it currently ends after `GameUI.bindSkills()`.
- Integrate starter equipment, loot affixes, and affix stat recalculation in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
- Validate gameplay, UI actions, save/load, combat, loot, death/respawn, and boss flow in a browser; save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked until `src/main.js` has a working bootstrap and event loop.

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` lifecycle and wire controls in `index.html`.
2. Preserve existing uncommitted changes and integrate starter gear, affixes, and affix stats in `src/player.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/inventory.js`.
3. Run syntax checks and start `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
4. Exercise gameplay flows in a browser, fix runtime issues, save `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-latest.jpg`, and read only that latest screenshot.
5. Review `git diff` and report assumptions, validation results, and remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists, but bootstrap, event wiring, and game loop are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, class selection, cinematic, HUD, panels, and gameplay controls that need wiring.
- `src/data.js`: Loot, affix, and starter gear definitions are present.
- `src/player.js`: `createPlayer()` has base-stat defaults; starter gear integration remains pending.
- `src/world.js`: Loot drops assign rarity and power but no affixes.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment recalculation currently uses equipment power only.
- `src/combat.js`: Contains the class-specific resource warning change.
- `src/progression.js`: Level-up progression.
- `src/save.js`: LocalStorage save/load functions.
- `styles.css`: UI presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; latest known status showed `src/combat.js`, `src/data.js`, and `src/player.js` modified.
- `GameUI` includes a dynamically rendered inventory panel; no bootstrap or game loop has been implemented.
- Main-menu, class selection, cinematic, pause, death, panel, dialogue, and HUD controls are in `index.html`.
- `World`, `Combat`, `Progression`, and `Inventory` expose the gameplay primitives needed for the bootstrap.
- Syntax checks and browser validation have not been run.
